name: Light Lens
summary: Two unequal fields of light, cut by a clear diagonal horizon. A striking identity for the changing prayer day.
why: An asymmetric lens separates into two luminous fields, reflecting the transition between daylight and night. The uninterrupted gap gives the small icon a strong silhouette, while the two colors suggest different moments within one day.
risk: Its link to prayer times is conceptual; without the app name it may suggest optics or an abstract planet.
sub1: Day and night in one rhythm
